in_greek.name: Ιπολύτη

in_latin.name: Hippolyta

in_english.name: Ipolita
in_english.long_meaning: the name Ipolita is derived from the Greek word hippos, meaning horse, and the feminine epithet hule, meaning many, and thus the name Ipolita means woman with many horses, and has historical and spiritual significance in early Christian tradition, associated with strength and freedom
